card.name: Inside foreign or local-language names
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of non-English words, such as folk plant names, place names and Japanese katakana, often in quotes or parentheses after an English term.

modes.label: Folk plant names
modes.description: Middle pieces of Portuguese or local plant names given in quotes beside Latin species names.

modes.label: Foreign titles and place names
modes.description: Inner pieces of Spanish, Turkish or Vietnamese titles and place names.

modes.label: Japanese katakana
modes.description: Repeated or inner katakana characters in the Japanese name of a game.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a foreign or local-language name that is quoted inside English text.
